adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` the `:category` / `-c` option and all related logic are removed, so existing scripted invocations using `-c` will now fail with an unknown option. Additionally, the import path changes from creating a topic via `PostCreator` with a permalink (`raw: "\[[Permalink](#{t[:link]})\]"`) to calling `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`, which performs a synchronous `open(url).read` remote HTTP fetch; this can raise/fail on unreachable links where the previous implementation could still create the topic and proceed. Both are concrete behavior regressions shown in the diff.
